newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products all firm, except gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products all firm, except gasoline.

text.p: Med oil products were firm, apart from gasoline which weakened with NYMEX unleaded futures, although closed arbitrage options to the U.S. meant the region was cushioned against the fall.
The Med is seen long in gasoline, with around two cargoes seen available in Italy in early October and one in southern France for the same time period, and few buyers.
Naphtha was strong as one trader sold to another trader at $216 cif NWE. But dealers assessed swaps numbers far below that level, despite a shortage of supply.
Gas oil was firm. At least two Russian cargoes were on offer, but buyers and sellers were distanced at premium differentials of quotes cif high +$2.25/+$3.50, basis Genoa.

The Greek buy tender which takes place on Tuesday morning was a major talking point in the market. Greece originally tendered for 500-600,000 tonnes of gas oil but many traders they could end up taking just under a million tonnes.

Mediterranean traders bandied about rough offers of between quotes cif high cif Greece to quotes cif high +$1.50 cif Greece, although many said it was impossible to assess where the offers would really come in.
Cracked fuel oil was pressured by swaps and talk supply was better than thought. A Portuguese tender was seen as supportive.

Dealers said at least three requirements for bunker spec high sulphur cracked fuel were met on Monday. One was done at fob high Med +$6 while another was at cif high plus below $2 cif Med. "The prices reflected the softer Med, and has taken away one of the support pillars," said one trader.

The low sulphur cracked market was active. Two deals were done. A major sold to a trader on a 50:50 fixed/floating basis at $119 fob Lavera and high fob +$1.75 and a trader sold to an end-user, also on 50:50 basis at $125.75 cif on the fixed price.
